The prior 2026-05-19 verification row therefore cannot be re-checked, and I could not confirm the seeded join against the document's own front matter. The verdict is undetermined on that ground alone. The corpus-side citation audit below did not need the document and is reported in full. CITATION AUDIT - and the finding here is on the corpus side. The key is cited in exactly ONE place: the cites[] array at observations/cfs-comparison-summary.ts:10. So the citation is manifest-level and NOT load-bearing. Moreover the prior ledger note claims it is 'cited via cites: [...] in cfs-comparison-summary.ts + algebraic-gns-embedding.ts'; the second half is wrong - grep finds no reference to this key in algebraic-gns-embedding.ts or in any of its four siblings in that directory. The relevance verdict stays undetermined because the document is gone and I cannot judge what its result would offer.
